original_ai_output.title_zh: 西加扎勒河州监狱过度拥挤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西加扎勒河州瓦乌中央监狱负责人表示，该州监狱设施过度拥挤，共有1025名在押人员，其中288人候审、146人等待执行死刑。他称拥挤部分源于北加扎勒河州和湖泊州的案件转入，并呼吁设立流动法庭加快审理。相关说法来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Wau Central Prison, Western Bahr el Ghazal State

key_facts.fact: 西加扎勒河州监狱共有1025名在押人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said there are 1,025 inmates across the state, with 146 on death row awaiting execution.

key_facts.fact: 其中288人候审、146人等待执行死刑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 288 have been remanded and are awaiting trial. ... I have 146 condemned prisoners in this main prison

key_facts.fact: 监狱拥挤被归因于北加扎勒河州和湖泊州案件转入
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: congestion is due to the transfer of inmates from Northern Bahr el Ghazal and Lakes states

key_facts.fact: 监狱负责人呼吁设立流动法庭加快审理候审案件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gen. Majok urges the establishment of mobile courts to expedite the hearing of cases of those on remand

uncertainties: 相关数据与原因说明均来自瓦乌中央监狱负责人单一来源，尚未获得独立交叉验证
